guidance: Move away from flowing water and low-lying routes and use a listed safer location if it is accessible
avoid: Do not walk drive or cycle through floodwater
escalation_note: Contact the relevant local emergency service if water is rising rapidly or a person is trapped

guidance: Move to higher ground when it is safe to do so and keep away from riverbanks drains and unstable structures
avoid: Do not return to a flooded building or cross moving water
escalation_note: Contact the relevant local emergency service for immediate danger or rescue needs

guidance: Move away from steep slopes falling material and visibly unstable ground when it is safe to do so
avoid: Do not remain below a moving slope or approach fresh cracks and fallen debris
escalation_note: Contact the relevant local emergency service if movement is active or a person is trapped

guidance: Use another recorded route only when the supplied information lists one and follow physical barriers and local instructions
avoid: Do not cross barriers floodwater fallen earth or unstable debris
escalation_note: Contact the relevant local authority if no safe route is known

guidance: Move away from immediate danger when possible and warn nearby people without placing yourself at further risk
avoid: Do not attempt a rescue that places you in danger
escalation_note: Contact the relevant local emergency service immediately

guidance: Use the supplied relief-point listing as a reference and confirm current access through the relevant local authority
avoid: Do not assume that a listed location has space supplies transport or medical capacity
escalation_note: Use emergency services for urgent rescue or medical needs
